why: A real memory service may outlive the initial <=30s start admission. Reusing expired admission denies valid status/stop and must not extend old proof.

api.owner: existing RootMemoryLifecycleRegistry and selected lifecycle authority/custody
api.inputs: Genuine retained owned process handle/terminal lineage only; no PID/profile/UID/source selector supplied by worker. Root registry independently resolves exact active memory enrollment, original start receipt and selected service/profile/generation/source closure.
api.checks: Fresh actual current installed controller PIDFD, selected enablement choice/adoption and policy/epoch, current selected artifact/prestart/source proof, held process identity/PIDFD/cgroup/mount/network namespace. Current proof expires<=30s and <=original process deadline; old admission immutable/expired. No new start effect or service deadline extension.
api.status: Fresh current same-process status permission; may not imply semantic readiness or model/capture permission.
api.stop: Fresh narrowly scoped same retained process stop authorization using existing fixed shutdown/grace policy. Actual memory enablement revocation prohibits future work and schedules root-owned cleanup using retained original process/PIDFD custody; revocation must not prevent necessary stop cleanup. Root cleanup is separate finite custody obligation, no new caller grant.
api.cleanup: Missing controller/consent/source currentness denies productive operations; retained root cleanup still terminates only exact originally owned live process or proves terminal state with no PID reuse/kill-by-number. Original deadline hard bound remains.
api.serialization: Reuse existing finite selected lifecycle status/stop payload and signer/verify/consume route; no new generic signer/session/worker RPC.

tasks.work: Fresh status/stop re-admission bound original process receipt with current controller/policy/source/enablement; independent revocation/deadline cleanup via retained PIDFD.
Service outlives initial admission; old lease denies, fresh same-process status/stop succeeds, changed generation/PID/revocation denies productive work and cleanup retains exact ownership.

acceptance: Meaningful process fixtures and actual target evidence separate. All AC and baseline unchanged.
